notes.title: Title Update 4!
notes.content:
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45195051/0abba5e0dee8f9a4198f9ff0db9a2d0d49f155bf.png"]
It's been busy at 4J Studios, and we have lots to update you on!

We've pushed multiple updates for the Pioneer Program on Xbox, improving stability, fixing community-reported bugs, and polishing the gameplay experience across the board.

Today we released our first major update!

Title Update 4 focuses on survival mode. The Mining Bracer can now be upgraded with rare Elements and Aura. To do this, you will need to delve deep underground, but new, dangerous mobs await you...


[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45195051/4123ea628b190d67e3e3601fc99993eb951358fd.png"]
But that's not all, other new features include:

Stations
Workbench - A station for making a number of useful items. 

Campfire - A simple, rustic method of cooking. Lit with an Ember Leaf. 

Kiln - Used to process ores and several other materials. Uses Charcoal for fuel. 


Cooking & Smelting
Cook meals at campfires to keep Pioneers well-fed.

Smelt items at kilns for refined materials.

Use Ember Leaves from Ember Stems to ignite your fires.


New Tools
Row Mining Tool – Perfect for clearing tunnels or terraforming.

Cylinder Tool – A brand-new sculpting option for builders to shape and expand bases in fresh ways.


Storage
Aura Storage Container

Iron Storage Crate

Storage Crate


Furniture & Decoration
Make your house a home with stools, tables, lanterns, and more.


Boomblock
Wrapping things up with a bang—the Boomblock is ready to cause some serious chaos.


But we are just getting started, check out everything else in the TU4 update trailer.

[previewyoutube="UHc8F7x7on8;full"][/previewyoutube]

Read the full patch notes and help shape the future of Reforj on our Discord. Sign up to be part of the Pioneer Program: Reforj.game


[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45195051/f8bcc3edf782c3346da37301306a09acad63d8ee.png"]

notes.title: Spiritual Minecraft successor Reforj transforms building tools in first update
notes.content:
With the Minecraft movie bringing Mojang's iconic sandbox even more to the forefront of our minds, there's always the lingering question about a possible Minecraft 2. While that seems unlikely in an official capacity, several teams have looked to put their own spin on the blocky building game. Among them is Reforj, built by Dundee-based 4J Studios, a team that previously worked on Minecraft itself (specifically porting it to consoles and handhelds). It's now available in an early pre-alpha form, and its first title update dramatically expands your building potential.
Read the rest of the story...

notes.title: Community Update
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45195051/5ad1e38ef6c2267a2ab7a4a37b003d9200d44614.png
March started with unveiling Reforj's first mob, the Tunneler Scout. This hostile creature hunts players, stealing their Aura as they deal damage. Players must protect this resource at all costs, as it is required in many crafting recipes such as the Aura Torch. The Tunneler Scout has a thick exoskeleton that protects it from direct attacks, so you must think carefully about how to defeat it.

[previewyoutube=y4rVxv59y08;full][/previewyoutube]

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45195051/a4a5a2082ea8c9638b959db0c5be2edfc380a8a0.png

Internal testing is also underway, and the team is busy reviewing a wide range of features every week in the studios. Here are a couple of screenshots of our favourite moments and landscapes.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45195051/bbe0907220c1eb111b4c896fac04c1fa3c45728e.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45195051/9ca6d6f8b9fbbfe1b8439814972e8fa74cbe6a97.png

Not stopping there, we implemented easy-to-learn building tools, intuitive crafting, and advanced creator tools. These features allow players to build more detailed objects faster and more efficiently. Our expert builders have been experimenting daily with what is possible in pre-alpha Reforj. Check out some of our favourite builds.

[previewyoutube=rrjl_8fljWU;leftthumb][/previewyoutube][previewyoutube=7661jVJj_qA;rightthumb][/previewyoutube]









{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45195051/9da9fd16051825ca90989ca0df049e6d1aeebc00.png
Finally, as we move into April, we introduce our second mob, a flightless bird. We're still naming this mob and are taking suggestions from the community in Discord!
